name: Las Horquetas to Camping Río Turbio (one night, out and back)
ref: GPT32 circuit stage / Wikiexplora Trekking Cerro Castillo; manual p.742, p.1229
dist: about 31 km total, about 15-17 km each way
terrain: 4x4 track, then marked trail in lenga forest and pastures; 5 unbridged streams (sometimes knee deep); gates with ladders; no exposure
cost: park ticket about 16,000 CLP (2024) to about 21,000 CLP; camping at CONAF site Río Turbio; no other fees known
caution: confirm out-and-back is allowed and the 2026/27 ticket; knee-deep fords are borderline (turn back if above the knee); trailhead pin approximate; entrance 07:00-13:00
why: quiet end of the Cerro Castillo park, an official overnight spot, avoids the busy Laguna trail

name: Sendero Laguna Chiguay (4 km loop)
terrain: easy forest and lagoon path, T1
caution: short filler only; the ranger post is also where Las Horquetas tickets are sold
why: easy stretch-your-legs stop on a driving day
